report:
Freshly reviewed the current complete claim, all five ordinary implementation associations, and all three ordinary associated tests. There are no TODO/N/A entries. Requirements are latest supported default edition under the repository pin, retention of an explicitly selected older supported edition, and setup rejection of unknown editions.

CompileTest::prepare takes the explicit string or defaults to 2024, validates it through Edition::parse before filesystem/compiler setup, writes it into the generated Cargo manifest, and passes it into rustc::check. The current scope implementation enumerates 2015/2018/2021/2024, round-trips those values through as_str, and maps all other strings to None. Metadata loads the actual selected Cargo target edition without overriding it. Driver uses that edition for its embedded compiler arguments, root module and local crate; local_crate_with_edition asserts crate/root agreement. The independent rustc adapter passes the chosen edition as --edition; its current execute/validate_output refactoring preserves those arguments and rejects failed execution or diagnostics inconsistent with markers. These five implementation entries collectively cover the entire selection and propagation path. Captured rust-toolchain.toml pins nightly-2026-03-15; rustc --help executed during this review identifies 2024 as latest stable edition. The experimental future spelling is not a concrete numbered fixture edition.

The complete associated tests supply meaningful assertions: default_edition_supplies_into_future_but_2021_does_not uses an IntoFuture-dependent program accepted under the omitted edition, then explicitly selects 2021, requires a shared ERROR, and asserts the returned Sage diagnostic contains unresolved trait. Successful prepare requires both compiler results to succeed; thus the contrasting inputs detect accidentally defaulting to the older edition or ignoring the explicit override on either path. The older 2015/2018 values use the same inspected option propagation and conversion path; 2021 provides the representative observable older-edition regression. unknown_edition_fails_setup supplies future and asserts the precise unknown-edition setup error. explicit_edition_and_rustc_warning_marker covers the public macro's edition field dispatch, 2021 preparation, a rustc-only warning marker and an empty Sage diagnostic expectation. Captured observe::collect and diagnostic matching code confirm that returned diagnostics are actual collected results and that shared ERROR markers must match each compiler, rather than serving as unconditional permission to pass. No opaque assertion helper hides the edition scenario.

This refresh involved source inspection and review start/read/record commands, plus rustc --help; no source edits or test executions were performed. The coordinator runs the relevant suites centrally. No earlier test result or approval was substituted for current source assessment. No behavioral defect or missing required evidence was identified.
